scenario.description: Patient wants to refill a lisinopril prescription.
scenario.goal: Refill request is submitted and patient receives confirmation of when it will be ready.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Hi, I need a refill on my lisinopril.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I can help with appointments. Would you like to schedule a visit?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: No, I just need a prescription refill for lisinopril.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Got it. Can you tell me what you're calling about today?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I already said -- I need a refill on my lisinopril prescription.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Sure, which medication would you like refilled?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Okay, I've submitted a refill request for lisinopril. It should be ready at your pharmacy in 24 hours.
